domains: 1. Time, synchronization, and the organization of daily existence
label: Civil timekeeping
original_text: 1001. **Civil timekeeping:** Shared clock conventions allow strangers and institutions to coordinate; inaccurate clocks can disrupt transportation, transactions, and emergency operations.
summary: Shared clock conventions allow strangers and institutions to coordinate; inaccurate clocks can disrupt transportation, transactions, and emergency operations.

domains: 1. Time, synchronization, and the organization of daily existence
label: Clock synchronization
original_text: 1002. **Clock synchronization:** Distributed networks, financial markets, scientific equipment, and communication systems depend on consistent timestamps; synchronization failures can corrupt records or sequencing.
summary: Distributed networks, financial markets, scientific equipment, and communication systems depend on consistent timestamps; synchronization failures can corrupt records or sequencing.

domains: 1. Time, synchronization, and the organization of daily existence
label: Time zones
original_text: 1003. **Time zones:** Make local civil schedules manageable across the planet; complicate international business, remote employment, communication, and emergency coordination.
summary: Make local civil schedules manageable across the planet; complicate international business, remote employment, communication, and emergency coordination.

domains: 1. Time, synchronization, and the organization of daily existence
label: Daylight-saving transitions
original_text: 1004. **Daylight-saving transitions:** Alter official schedules and seasonal daylight distribution; can disrupt sleep, transportation, software systems, and human routines.
summary: Alter official schedules and seasonal daylight distribution; can disrupt sleep, transportation, software systems, and human routines.

domains: 1. Time, synchronization, and the organization of daily existence
label: Calendar systems
original_text: 1005. **Calendar systems:** Organize dates, records, history, agriculture, and administration; differences between systems can create misunderstandings and scheduling errors.
summary: Organize dates, records, history, agriculture, and administration; differences between systems can create misunderstandings and scheduling errors.

domains: 1. Time, synchronization, and the organization of daily existence
label: Fiscal years
original_text: 1006. **Fiscal years:** Establish accounting and reporting cycles; can encourage organizations to prioritize short-term targets over long-term performance.
summary: Establish accounting and reporting cycles; can encourage organizations to prioritize short-term targets over long-term performance.

domains: 1. Time, synchronization, and the organization of daily existence
label: School-year schedules
original_text: 1007. **School-year schedules:** Coordinate education, family routines, childcare, and employment; can create unequal burdens on working households.
summary: Coordinate education, family routines, childcare, and employment; can create unequal burdens on working households.

label: Deadlines
